subject: English
title: 從什麼時候開始生病

panels.heading: 問的是生病起點
panels.text: since when 兩個字共同詢問起點。
panels.alt: 正在生病和從什麼時候的情境
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

panels.heading: 從開始生病到現在
panels.text: 現在完成式 have been 從較早起點連到現在。
panels.alt: 由圖形對照起點未知和現在仍生病
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

panels.heading: 把 you 放在 have 前
panels.text: since when 詢問起點，本句接 you have been。
panels.alt: 圖解 since when、you、have been sick 的順序
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

fourth.answer: Does your husband know since when you have been sick?
points: since when 詢問起點，本句接 you have been。
fourth.alt: Does … know與生病的起點的圖示，標出 since when

answerCheckedAgainst: Does your husband know since when you have been sick?
rationale: 用原生向量物件和語法圖示對照情境、角色、句子骨架和答案，四格各有獨立圖資。
